timing: Read-only world tick and max8 boss.skillReleases records written only by successful own-boss projectile emission or laser activation. Future, negative, expired and missing releases do not create release effects. Legacy fallback requires releaseTick>=0. Optional charge accents do not replace geometric damage warnings.
renderOrder: Source accents are drawn below actors, warnings, damage bodies and player. Actual release anchors outside the upper battle area are omitted, not teleported onto another target.
failures: Skill, rotor ornament and beam ornament sources are optional and are omitted on missing/wrong dimensions. Existing required same-boss material damage sources remain mandatory and fail closed if missing. There is no geometric or foreign-actor visual fallback.
animationClaim: All reused images are static single-frame art. A bounded pulse/fade, spin, or nine-slice texture fit does not establish authored animation frames. No complete continuous animation is claimed.
validation: tests/legacy-h14-source-skills.test.cjs uses exact pinned source hashes and native CPU Canvas: 12 own source contracts, release timing, read-only rendering, draw/cache caps, transparent hidden RGB, seven large rotor spin/previews, exact beam clip and dense alpha coverage. This is not a GPU/mobile/browser/natural-clear result.
